summary: This note summarizes Paisius of Hilendar, an 18th-century Bulgarian monk. It describes his birthplace, his years at the Hilandar monastery on Mount Athos, and his research for his historical work. The note highlights that his book was the first attempt at a complete history of Bulgaria and aimed to awaken Bulgarian national consciousness.
one_line: Biography of Paisius of Hilendar, the 18th-century monk whose 1762 history was the first complete history of Bulgaria.
key_facts: Paisius was born in the Samokov eparchy of the time, probably in the town of Bansko.
Paisius established himself in the Hilandar monastery on Mount Athos in 1745.
Paisius was later a hieromonk and deputy-abbot at the Hilandar monastery.
Paisius spent two years collecting materials for his history through hard work.
Paisius visited the Habsburg Monarchy while collecting materials for his history.
Paisius completed "Istoriya Slavyanobolgarskaya" in the Zograf Monastery.
The book "Istoriya Slavyanobolgarskaya" was the first attempt to write a complete history of Bulgaria.
The book "Istoriya Slavyanobolgarskaya" attempted to awake and strengthen Bulgarian national consciousness.
